title: False SRG(33,8,2,2) W33 constellation quarantine
purpose: Audit and remove the newly landed Pass4801-4812 packet that redefines W33 as a 33-vertex SRG, conflicts with canonical pass ownership, and promotes failed count and subgroup tests to physics claims; replace it with an exact GAP-backed falsification record.
outcome: SRG(33,8,2,2) fails the strongly-regular feasibility equation (48 != 40), and the independent spectrum and PSL(2,32) action routes also fail. The false colliding artifacts have been removed while the falsification provenance remains executable.
boundary: This quarantine does not classify all strongly regular graphs or derive any physics from the canonical W33 graph. The canonical W33 point graph remains SRG(40,12,2,4).
